name: 03_fold_towel
title: Folding Cloth and Clearing Counter
summary: The robot folds a cloth, covers a sponge with it while inspecting the sink, and returns to uncover and use the sponge.
robot: two white robot arms with parallel grippers
setting: a kitchen counter next to a stainless steel sink

source.original_prompt: Fold the cloth from right to left

segments.instruction: Grasp the right edge of the brown cloth with the right gripper and lift it toward the center while the camera stays fixed.
Fold the cloth over to the left side and release it, then pat it flat with both grippers.
Pick up the folded cloth with the right gripper and drape it over the yellow sponge near the sink corner.
segments.memory_event: hide: yellow sponge covered entirely by the folded brown cloth

segments.instruction: Turn the camera down toward the sink basin and reach the left gripper toward the drain.
segments.memory_event: hide: countertop and covered sponge exit camera view to the right

segments.instruction: Inspect the sink drain and rinse the left gripper under the faucet area while keeping the camera focused on the basin.
Turn the camera back up and right to center on the countertop.
segments.memory_event: return: countertop view returns showing the green bottle and the folded brown cloth covering the sponge at the sink edge

segments.instruction: Grasp the folded cloth with the right gripper, lift it off, and place it to the right.
segments.memory_event: return: yellow sponge is uncovered and resting in the same position

segments.instruction: Pick up the sponge with the left gripper and wipe down the empty counter area.
